title: Danee C NDE 7048
content: I felt bubbles in my chest. I told the technicians that were in the room. I sat down on the bed, turned my head toward my husband. I could only see part of him, like through a scope. I intended to say, 'I feel like I'm dying conscious.' It came out as a cold, flat, 'I just want to die.' I didn't want to die and our 12-year-old son was in the room. I'd have never said that in front of him. It still has him scarred! I vaguely remember having a seizure type of jerking reaction to the drug. Then there was nothing. I was later told that I struggled and fought so much that they had to strap me down. I needed to be sedated so they could intubate me. I'm still waiting on the copies of the medical records; I'm hoping they're thorough and accurate. As for my experience with the nothing: it was a moment and an eternity. There was complete darkness, yet it was so peaceful that I cannot describe it. I was aware of my soul and aware that I was free from my body. There was no time like the one we have here while alive, on earth. Time felt stretched, but afterwards only seemed like a few seconds. I was aware of and thought of my children. Then I became aware that 'everything is as it should be.' It was as if someone had spoken it in their mind and I read their thoughts. It was as if I was just visiting. I felt complete and total peace. I had no idea that existed, before that moment. When I came back, I saw myself strapped down, intubated, and swollen. I saw everyone around me, patients in their rooms, nurses and doctors going back and forth, and completely unaware of me. Then it was like I blinked and opened my eyes and I was in my body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Reaction to a drug during a medical procedure; seizure-like jerking; required sedation and intubation.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience of 'nothing' / complete darkness with profound peace; telepathic-like message: "everything is as it should be."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Seizure-like reaction/blackout → darkness/peace with timelessness → awareness of being free of body and thinking of children → OBE observing self strapped down/intubated and staff/patients → sudden return by blinking/opening eyes in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Complete darkness described as 'nothing' yet profoundly peaceful; perception of a thought/message as if reading someone else's mind: "everything is as it should be."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "There was complete darkness, yet it was so peaceful that I cannot describe it." "everything is as it should be."
